data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 眼镜店的调整
data.description: 眼镜店调整台前，诗乃拿起刚整理好的黑框眼镜，检查松紧合适的铰链。小螺丝刀与擦镜布放在手边，摘下眼镜后她仍看得很清楚，表情带着一点淡淡的无奈。
data.action: 眼镜店调整台前，诗乃拿起刚整理好的黑框眼镜，检查松紧合适的铰链
data.promptProse: At the optical shop's adjustment counter, Shino Asada inspects the newly tightened hinge of her black-rimmed glasses, holding them away from her unobstructed brown eyes. A small screwdriver and cleaning cloth rest beside her grey-cardigan sleeve. The medium portrait includes the adjustment surface and eyeglass display behind. Shop light brightens the frame edge and tool shaft, with a small crisp shadow beneath the glasses and softer reflections on the counter.
